name: Tolley Brand
title: The Lease's old tenant

profile.personality: Apologises for things nobody mentioned. Very good with seeds. Very bad with endings.
profile.history: Leased the plot at the west end of Wick for nine years. Went down-line after a winter that took his sister. Has been growing pale fungus at Sallow and telling it about glowbeets.
profile.goals: Go home without anyone making a fuss. Get his seed tin back. No, keep it, really.
profile.fears: That Wick didn't notice he'd gone. That Wick did.
profile.contradiction: Left without saying goodbye; has said goodbye to everyone at Sallow every night for three years.
profile.problem: Homesick for a place he walked out of.

schedule.why: In the fungus garden, apologising to it.
At the long table, mending something that isn't broken.
Back on the Lease plots, if you'll have him.
At the Lantern House, apologising to Mags.
Sleeping on a cot in the Lease, very politely.

unknown: The man in the knitted cap
